title: A first closing with no baseline reports an assumed source change although the measured content never changed, so Engram refuses the evaluation of a clean check
outcome: A registered clean check in a newly named or recovered root can be evaluated without an unobserved source change being attributed to it, and a real source change after the check is still refused.
acceptance: Evaluation of a clean registered check on a first closing in a named root is admitted when the measured content is unchanged, either through a genuine baseline established before the check or through a documented supported order; the choice and its reason are agreed with Engram's coordinator and recorded here
A deterministic test shows a real source change after the check is still refused with source_moved_after_check, and Engram's refusal isn't loosened
A pinned disposable join of the failing sequence on the installed Engram passes on the changed input
